question: Reading Surat An-Nas
answer: Qul a'oozu birabbin naas; Malikin naas; Ilaahin naas; Min sharril waswaasil khannaas; Allazee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin naas; Minal jinnati wannaas

question: Tell the meaning of Surat
answer: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord And Cherisher of Mankind; The King (or Ruler) Of Mankind; The God (or Judge) Of Mankind
